subject: Urgent: P95 latency lift — coordination, temporary mitigations, and playbook request
messages:
From: Samantha Perez <samantha@brightcart.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@brightcart.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Spike in p95 latency on carts-api — observed since 07:30 PT

Marissa / Karthik,

We started seeing p95 request latency for our carts-api jumps from ~180ms to ~1.2s at ~07:30 PT this morning. Impact is intermittent but noticeable during our morning peak (roughly 07:30–09:00). Some customers are reporting slower checkout flows. Attached is a telemetry snapshot from 07:25–08:00 showing increased service time for generation calls.

Questions: can you confirm whether this is model-side (inference) or network/infra? We are watching error rates (no increase) and request rates look roughly flat.

Thanks — can someone triage urgently and advise temporary mitigations we can enact?

Samantha
Ops Lead, BrightCart

Attachment: p95-telemetry-snapshot.png

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Perez <samantha@brightcart.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Spike in p95 latency on carts-api — observed since 07:30 PT

Thanks for the heads up, Samantha — we see the same signal in our infra dashboards. I'm initiating an internal triage now.

Immediate asks from our side:
- SRE: can you confirm whether the spike correlates with any kernel scheduling or GC events on the serving fleet? (Sean)
- Runtime/infra: check whether a quantized model variant rollouts or kernel selector change went live around 07:00–07:30. (Karthik)
- Product: I'll draft a short customer-facing note; need an ETA for mitigation and whether a temporary routing policy or throttling is required. (Marissa)

Please treat this as high priority. If we identify a safe temporary mitigation (e.g., route to a slightly higher-cost variant with lower tail latency, enable prefix caching for the affected route, or throttle non-essential background requests) we'll communicate next steps to BrightCart.

I'll collect triage notes into a runbook draft and share for sign-off.

- Marissa
Principal PM, Product Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Perez <samantha@brightcart.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Spike in p95 latency on carts-api — initial hypothesis and quick mitigations

Quick summary from runtime side (initial):
- No rollout events in the model control plane at 07:00–07:30; model version pinned for BrightCart.
- Kernel scheduler logs show increased variance on a subset of GPU nodes (node group: gpu-pool-7). We're seeing occasional scheduling stalls that align with the p95 spikes.
- KV cache hit rates for carts-api dropped ~12% during the window — likely due to a short-lived prefix-invalidating event (maybe a malformed prompt pattern).

Recommended temporary mitigations (safe-first):
1) Route BrightCart traffic for carts-api to gpu-pool-5 (different zone) for the next 30–60 minutes while we observe (will add small cross-region cost).
2) Re-enable conservative prefix caching for carts-api (previously tuned down) — should reduce tail latency for repeated flows.
3) If route change isn't possible quickly, enable a mild rate-limiter on background embedding/batch jobs for BrightCart customer token to free up capacity.

I'll open an infra task to cordon suspect nodes for deeper investigation; Sean, can SRE coordinate switchover timings and any capacity reservation?

-Karthik
Staff Software Engineer, Serving Runtime

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Perez <samantha@brightcart.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Spike in p95 latency on carts-api — triage, actions, and runbook draft

Triage update and immediate playbook items:
- Confirmed: node-group gpu-pool-7 exhibiting kernel scheduling jitter. We've isolated and cordoned two nodes (gpu-7b, gpu-7d). Removing them from rotation reduced p95 by ~380ms in Canary.
- Action taken: temporarily routed BrightCart traffic to gpu-pool-5 (switchover at 09:45 PT). Observed p95 return to ~220ms in that window.
- Runbook draft attached (mitigation-runbook-draft.pdf) — includes step-by-step for: node cordon, route override, cache toggles, and rollback.

Outstanding asks for product/eng:
- Product to approve short customer-facing note (2–3 lines) describing that we identified a GPU scheduling issue and that we've applied a routing mitigation; message should include expected impact (reduced tail latency) and invite ops to re-open if they still see issues. (Marissa)
- Eng: agree on a postmortem owner and a timeline for full remediation (kernel/driver updates vs. hardware replacement). I'd recommend eng own immediate follow-up and SRE own monitoring remediation.

I'll keep the runbook in the drive link and will push a stable version by EOD. If we need to escalate to dedicated capacity or invoke a reserved-capacity fallback, flag it here.

- Sean
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachment: mitigation-runbook-draft.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Perez <samantha@brightcart.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Spike in p95 latency on carts-api — customer note and next steps

Samantha — thanks for rapid partnership. Below is a short message we plan to send to your ops and product teams; please let me know if wording is acceptable and who from BrightCart will publish any internal notes.

--- CUSTOMER-FACING NOTE (proposed) ---
We identified a GPU scheduling issue in our serving fleet that caused increased p95 latency for some requests earlier today. We have applied a routing mitigation which returned tail latency to expected ranges. Our teams are investigating the root cause and will share a postmortem with next steps. If you continue to see elevated latency, please reply to this thread and we will prioritize.

--- END NOTE ---

Next steps we will own:
- Internal postmortem kickoff (owner: Jonas Weber) — target doc by 2027-07-02.
- Full remediation plan (kernel update vs node replacement) due in 7 business days.
- Customer follow-up postmortem once we have RCA and timelines.

Sean / Karthik: I've approved the runbook changes you proposed. Sean, please publish the runbook version to the drive link and notify ops when it's stable.

Who will send the customer note? I'd like to send once BrightCart confirms wording — target: within 30 minutes of confirmation.

Thanks everyone for quick response.

- Marissa
Principal PM, Product Reliability
Redwood Inference
